name: issue-triage
title: Triage a repository's newest issues (the scripted run uses synthetic issues, not a real repository's)
claim: Twenty issues are researched, labelled by Jev against five labels, judged as good first issues, and scored against the maintainers' own labels, and a run killed mid-way finishes without repeating a paid call.

kills.why: a typed question is in flight when the process dies; the resumed run takes its recorded answer and asks no second time
